# Repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository routing and safeguards.

IDE work lives in `ide/`; follow [the IDE instructions](../ide/.github/copilot-instructions.md) and run its commands
from that directory. IDE specifications are in `docs/ide/`. The standalone extension is in `extension/`; follow
[its instructions](../extension/AGENTS.md). Its specification is in `docs/extension/`.

For Facade Code Framework, use [Facade Code Framework engineering](../docs/framework/ENGINEERING.md) and the
[island index](../docs/framework/ARCHITECTURE.md#islands). The
[compatibility review](../docs/framework/ENGINEERING.md#compatibility-contracts) applies to published wire
and stored data changes. Follow the repository's [README approval rule](../AGENTS.md#readme-approval).
